page: Microsoft Azure DC4ads_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCADSv5 family. It features an x86_64 AMD processor with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration includes 154 GB of local SSD storage and supports Premium Storage options for external disk attachments. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its balanced resource allocation and dedicated CPU cores, the DC4ads_v5 offers a cost-effective profile for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the overhead of high-end memory or GPU accelerators. It is suitable for general-purpose applications, web serving, small databases, and development environments.
description: Microsoft Azure DC4ads_v5 is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine from the DCADSv5 family, powered by an AMD processor and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. Storage needs are met by 154 GB of local SSD capacity alongside Premium Storage compatibility for expandable disk configurations. The instance does not include dedicated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With its dedicated compute allocation and local solid-state storage, this server provides a stable, cost-efficient foundation for standard business applications. It is designed for workloads such as web serving, application hosting, and small-scale database deployments that require consistent performance without the overhead of specialized hardware.
